_notes.stockSpreadAssumed: Bid-ask spread used for S&P 500 stocks, which have no published median spread. Listed as an assumption in every run summary.
_notes.fundSpreadAssumed: Used only when a fund's published median spread is blank in funds.json. Listed as an assumption.
_notes.confirmedEvents: Add {"ticker": "XYZ", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "why"} to accept a daily move over the limit after checking it is real, such as a stock split.
_notes.pauseSeconds: Pause between Yahoo requests, to stay well clear of its rate limits.
